variants.name: Terminal
variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE finished macOS Dock app icon for Remote Codex, a desktop app for directing remote coding agents. Square 1024x1024 image. A single centered macOS rounded-square tile occupies about 84% of the canvas, with consistent empty transparent margins on every side. Smooth continuous Apple-style corners, not a circle. Crisp silhouette and outstanding legibility at 32px. Refined modern native desktop product aesthetic, restrained tactile depth, bold simple shapes, very clean edges. No app name, no captions, no labels, no watermark, no mockup scene, no additional icons, no checkerboard. The area OUTSIDE the rounded-square tile must be genuinely transparent. Concept 1, TERMINAL: luminous warm-white porcelain tile with a large near-black terminal prompt glyph, a strong angled chevron on the left and a short baseline underscore on the right. Extremely simple, perfectly balanced, beautifully proportioned; the chevron and underscore form one compact commanding symbol. Only those two dark elements. White tile, near-black glyph. Slight bevel and soft material highlight, no decorative lines or rainbow effects.
